name: DCS Brazilian Navy
summary: AI ship pack with Brazilian Navy vessels including NAM Atlantico, Niteroi and Greenhalgh class frigates.
description: Adds the A-140 Atlantico carrier, Niteroi and Greenhalgh class frigates, Amazonas/Grajau/Macae patrol ships, the Bahia landing ship and more. Extract into `Saved Games\DCS`. Removing ships from older versions can corrupt missions that use them.

releases.changelog: Niteroi class gained Exocet, Aspide and Bofors 40mm; SH-60B livery added; NAM Atlantico reworked.
